description: This file implements a WebSocket to SPDY stream translator for proxying container streams in Kubernetes, including handling WebSocket connections, SPDY executor setup, stream throttling, and terminal resize events.

classes.name: StreamTranslatorHandler
classes.description: A handler that translates WebSocket stream data to SPDY protocol for proxying to kubelet or container runtime.

classes.name: translatorSizeQueue
classes.description: Implements TerminalSizeQueue interface to handle terminal resize events from WebSocket.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, upgrades to WebSocket, sets up SPDY executor, and manages stream forwarding.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next terminal size from the resize channel.

methods.name: codeExitToStatusError
methods.description: Converts a CodeExitError into a StatusError for reporting container exit status.
